auth: Requires a Bearer token for the current authenticated user, unless noted.

endpoints.description: Lists pending team invitations addressed to the current user (matched by phone number), shown right after signup so an invited staff/front-desk member can join their business.
Accepts or declines a pending team invitation. Accepting grants the responding user the invited role on that business.

errors.message: No pending invitation found for this id
This invitation has already been accepted or declined

endpoints.screen: Invite team member (business-owner app, Team tab "+")
endpoints.description: Post-publish equivalent of business-setup.json#invite-team-member (onboarding's Team invite step), but collects the fuller field set that step never asked for: name, commission split, and working days. At least one of email/phone is required. An invitation IS the team roster record — there's no separate 'member' entity — so this returns the same shape list-my-invitations/get-business-profile-style team lists would use.

errors.message: This email or phone already has a pending invitation
This person is already on the team

endpoints.description: Edits a team member's commission split and/or working days. Works the same whether the member's invitation is still pending or already accepted — no separate 'accepted member' record exists to edit instead. Only the fields sent are changed; send workingDays: null to clear it. Returns the full member.

errors.message: invitationId does not exist for this business

endpoints.description: Cancels a still-pending invitation, or removes an already-accepted member from the team — same request either way, the meaning just depends on the record's current status. Removing an accepted member also removes their staff record.

endpoints.description: All invitations/members for the business, with name, role, status, commissionPercent and workingDays. The Team screen currently shows only members added on this device in this session (client memory), so it's empty after a reinstall or on a second device.
